test: the hunt scored the published way, with the oracle demoted to a shadow
run: habitat world, accepted walker (lab, no policy), eye on, scripted creep, 1500 steps, seed 1
reading: The dominant failure is DETECTION RATE, not detection quality. The eye reports something on 5.4 % of steps, and when it does the bearing is usable more often than not -- 44 usable against 37 wrong. That is a different problem from the one this project has been working on for three sessions, which assumed the bearing was the broken part.
why_this_run_matters: It is the first hunt scored by path efficiency rather than capture, and the first where a failure can be attributed. Before this, 'the eye cannot see the cricket' and 'the eye sees it and the body cannot get there' produced the same number.
